security_audit.summary: The audit found one confirmed security issue: a troubleshooting example uses sudo to modify firewall rules. The remaining static findings are Markdown examples, private sample addresses, documentation links, or local placeholder database paths, with no evidence of prompt injection or malicious intent.

remediation.issue: Privileged firewall command in troubleshooting guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the sudo firewall command with a note that operators must review firewall changes and approve them manually.

remediation.issue: Runnable network and database commands appear in documentation examples.
remediation.suggestion: Label commands as examples and state that agents must not run them without explicit user confirmation.

remediation.issue: Example database paths could be confused with production data.
remediation.suggestion: Clarify that sample database names are placeholders and recommend backups before import, merge, or optimization steps.

content.value_statement: Advanced AgentDB work needs clear patterns for sync, search, and database routing. This skill gives focused examples for distributed AI data systems.
actual_capabilities: Explains QUIC synchronization settings for AgentDB peers.
Compares cosine, Euclidean, dot product, and custom distance metrics.
Shows hybrid search patterns that combine vectors with metadata filters.
Describes multi-database routing and sharding patterns for separate domains.
Covers MMR and context synthesis for diverse retrieval results.
Documents import, export, optimization, and troubleshooting commands.
limitations: Assumes Node.js, AgentDB, and vector search knowledge.
Provides examples, not a complete production application.
Network and firewall commands require human review before use.
Does not replace load testing, backup planning, or security review.

use_cases.title: Design Distributed Memory Sync
use_cases.description: Plan how AgentDB peers share patterns over QUIC with ports, peers, retry settings, and batching.

use_cases.title: Tune Retrieval Quality
use_cases.description: Select distance metrics, metadata filters, MMR settings, and context synthesis options for better search results.

use_cases.title: Prepare Operational Runbooks
use_cases.description: Document database export, import, optimization, monitoring, and troubleshooting steps for AgentDB deployments.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Core Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain the main AgentDB advanced features in this skill. Focus on QUIC sync, hybrid search, and distance metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Hybrid Search Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an AgentDB hybrid search workflow for my domain. Include metadata filters, ranking weights, and result diversity settings.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Multi-Database Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my AgentDB multi-database design. Identify routing, sharding, backup, monitoring, and failure handling concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Production Readiness Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production readiness checklist for an AgentDB deployment with QUIC sync, local databases, imports, exports, and operational safeguards.

output_examples.input: Plan QUIC synchronization for three AgentDB nodes.
output_examples.output: A deployment outline with peer addresses, UDP port review, sync interval choices, retry settings, and operator approval steps.

output_examples.input: Improve retrieval quality for product search.
output_examples.output: A recommendation to combine vector similarity, category filters, rating filters, weighted scoring, and MMR for diverse results.

output_examples.input: Prepare maintenance steps for a vector database.
output_examples.output: A runbook covering backups, imports, exports, vacuuming, index rebuilds, monitoring, and rollback planning.

best_practices: Review all network and privileged commands before execution.
Test distance metrics with representative embeddings and real evaluation data.
Back up databases before imports, merges, optimization, or index rebuilds.
anti_patterns: Running troubleshooting commands with elevated privileges without approval.
Using sample private IP addresses unchanged in production deployments.
Changing search metrics without measuring relevance, diversity, and latency.

faq.question: Does this skill execute commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides documentation examples that a user or agent must review before running.

faq.question: What AgentDB areas does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers QUIC sync, distance metrics, hybrid search, multiple databases, MMR, context synthesis, and operations.

faq.question: Is it suitable for beginners?
faq.answer: It is best for users who already understand Node.js, vector search, and distributed systems basics.

faq.question: Can I use it for production planning?
faq.answer: Yes, but it should be paired with security review, backups, monitoring, and load testing.

faq.question: Does it include real database files?
faq.answer: No. The database names are examples used in documentation snippets.

faq.question: Why does the audit mention security risk?
faq.answer: One example uses sudo to change firewall rules, so that step requires explicit human approval.
